title: Native form reset
test: native reset restores both ownership modes
disposition: Required controlled name and uncontrolled email defaults share a native form, explicit host reset, submit handling and local operation result.

title: Host-owned asynchronous search
test: async search retains selection and rejects superseded results through failure and retry
disposition: A bounded 350ms mock request owns pending/error/retry; AbortController cleanup and a freshness guard protect query replacement/unmount, while selections stay independent.

title: Local datetime and host timezone
test: host timezone conversion rejects ambiguity and supports deliberate resolution
disposition: Public dateTimeToInstant resolves a local datetime with an explicit IANA zone and reject/earlier/later clock-change policy; civil dates remain separate.

title: Localized civil calendar presentation
test: locale scopes format the same civil range independently
disposition: Independent de-DE/ar-EG locale scopes display the same ISO civil range and disclose America/Chicago reference context; source includes the required locale adapter and Provider.

title: Independent navigation and long content
test: AppShell course navigation and lessons preserve separate scroll positions
disposition: Thirty navigation entries and twenty-four lesson paragraphs overflow independently in a bounded AppShell; the optional third column and existing responsive shell contract remain available.

title: Long authentication form and footer
test: long authentication form scrolls to fields, action and footer
disposition: A bounded long form supplies seven required fields, consent, native validation, a host-owned result and longer help/privacy footer; no account API is implied.

title: Primary actions and deep breadcrumbs
test: page header supplies primary actions and condensed ancestors
disposition: The public actionButtons slot contains a neutral SplitAction; five breadcrumb levels condense middle ancestors into Show path while keeping the current page and host-owned callbacks.

title: Controlled server criteria and response ownership
test: server criteria accept results, discard late responses and recover from rejection
disposition: One controlled criteria owner accepts combined page/search/sort/filter/selection transactions. A local async adapter rejects stale success/error/pending updates and demonstrates failure/retry without diagnostic resolve buttons.

title: Persisted view and complete reset
test: isolated persisted view survives reload and reset restores declared defaults
disposition: An isolated docs-course-view-v1 key opts into SSR-safe persistence; declared pagination/search/sort/filter/visibility/order/width/list defaults drive Reset view. Selection and host rows are not persisted.

title: Due labels and course content
test: learner due matrix uses the fixed host clock and retains missing-date fallback
disposition: A fixed host clock covers overdue/today/tomorrow/later plus long/missing supporting content. The required dueAt prop uses its shipped empty-string unavailable-date fallback; no optional API is invented.

title: Saved rich document
test: saved rich documents render public JSON in independent editable and read-only panels
disposition: Separate editable/read-only owners render public JSON containing headings, formatted/link text, list, code, table and a loaded host-served image; edits stay local.

title: Host upload and retry
test: host image adapter preserves a rejected upload for retry and inserts a durable asset
disposition: The bounded onUploadImage mock rejects once and returns a predefined durable /course-guide.svg asset on retry. It explicitly does not transfer selected bytes; the host owns transport, authorization, asset metadata and storage.
